description: This file contains build configuration, variable definitions, and build rules for the u-boot package in an OpenWrt build system, including target-specific build instructions and installation procedures.

methods.name: Package/u-boot/install/default
methods.description: Defines the default installation procedure for the u-boot package, copying the u-boot image to the specified directory.

methods.name: U-Boot/Init
methods.description: Initializes U-Boot build parameters such as target, subtarget, device, name, dependencies, and image name.

methods.name: Build/U-Boot/Target
methods.description: Defines build steps for a specific U-Boot target, including initialization, default setup, and target-specific build commands.

methods.name: Package/u-boot-$(1)
methods.description: Defines package metadata for a specific U-Boot variant, including section, category, title, dependencies, and URL.

methods.name: Build/Configure/U-Boot
methods.description: Configures the U-Boot build environment by running make with appropriate configuration variables.

methods.name: Build/Compile/U-Boot
methods.description: Compiles U-Boot using make with cross-compile settings and optional device tree compiler.

methods.name: BuildPackage/U-Boot/Defaults
methods.description: Sets default build configuration and compile steps for U-Boot package.

methods.name: BuildPackage/U-Boot
methods.description: Orchestrates the building of U-Boot package, including target-specific build steps and default targets.
